subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode — the roadmap

question: Should OpenClaw accept Codex-style structured questions, plan mode, and unattended goal continuation as core runtime features now, and should the paired implementation land together or be split?
rationale: The request adds cross-surface core behavior, protocol/API events, UI/channel rendering, and goal-driver semantics, which is a maintainer product and ownership decision rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Split staged core PRs
options.body: Keep this hub open and ask for separate reviewable PRs for the question pipeline, plan mode, and goal driver with focused proof for each surface.

options.title: Sponsor full branch
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the broad review cost and drive the paired implementation branch through proof, conflict, and security review.

options.title: Defer or narrow
options.body: Maintainers can reject or narrow the roadmap if these primitives should wait, move behind plugin/API design, or stay outside core for now.

recommendation.title: Split staged core PRs
recommendation.body: Keep this hub open and ask for separate reviewable PRs for the question pipeline, plan mode, and goal driver with focused proof for each surface.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-history connection to update_plan and strict-agentic runtime gating, which are central to this product direction.
